# HEPATITIS C

## Treatment of acute disease

Most acute disease is asymptomatic or mild. Patients with acute hepatitis C should be referred to the Hepatitis C clinic. Treatment may be indicated for disease that persists beyond 2 months.

## Chronic disease treatment

Antiviral therapy for chronic hepatitis C is a complicated, highly specialized task.

## Inpatient

Consult Gastroenterology and Infectious Diseases.
